main.description: A shared-watchlist entry: one show a member wants to watch, written into that member's own space-repo. rkey is 'tmdb-<id>' so an add is idempotent per show.

mediaType.description: Media type of the work. Watchlist entries are TV shows today.

year.description: Release year (four digits), denormalized for display.

addedAt.description: When the show was added to the watchlist.
